# Quantum Delayed Syndrome Decoder

> A streaming instrument preserves the exact flag-discrimination optimum with one coherent qubit for a delayed repetition-code syndrome. A four-flag biased example certifies a strict gap against immediate joint measurement followed by classical storage.

## Learning and reproduction

- [Watrous bridge](learning/WATROUS_BRIDGE.md)
- [30 milestones](learning/MILESTONES.md)
- [Verification commands and expected outputs](verification/README.md)

Preserve the timing of the syndrome, the pure flagged Pauli model and the distinction between a fixed-prior comparison and the all-prior memory converse. The adaptive single-flag exponent has a different scope from the finite bound against arbitrary early joint POVMs. Noise statements specify their channel and point of occurrence.
